limitations: Group independence and comparability require human evidence; software checks declarations and overlap.
No confidence/prediction intervals; residual error is not measurement uncertainty.
Grouped errors alone do not authorize predictions or prove geometry effects.
Small group counts yield unstable estimates; minimum counts are engineering gates, not statistical proof.

data_validation.note: Readiness is not scientific validation or proof of independence.

geometry_comparison.interpretation: Negative changes favor geometry on these held-out records only; no causality or general benefit established.

config.geometry_rationale: Synthetic generator deliberately includes width; not a physical law.
